fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker visible from the road at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear sightlines and unobstructed vehicle access from the road to the residence.
• Clear a path along at least one side of the residence wide enough for responders on foot to move between the front and rear of the property.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the detached structure to create open space between the plants and the building walls.
• Keep the patio area clear of stored items that could block responder movement around the rear of the residence.
• Mark or identify any side gate latches and hardware so responders can locate and open them quickly without searching.
• Thin dense plantings near the main residence that could slow or block responder movement along the exterior walls.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin trees in clusters near the structure to open space between individual trees.
• Remove or cut back shrubs growing against or immediately next to the house.
• Clear ground vegetation growing beneath trees that are close to the structure.
• Thin scattered trees and shrubs located between structures to reduce connected vegetation.
• Keep low branches pruned up from the base of large trees near the house.
• Mow or cut ground vegetation growing beneath and around scattered trees close to structures.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from shrubs growing near the house.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
• Maintain open ground between tree clusters and the nearest structure.
